title: Outside Painting of Lighthouse Tower at Tajpur Lighthouse, West Bengal
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for painting the outside surface of the lighthouse tower at Tajpur Lighthouse, West Bengal, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, payable at Kolkata; valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; original EMD must reach office by last date of bid submission.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in Building civil work category with Central govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State govt
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%
Similar works: repairs & maintenance or construction work of any type of building (RCC or masonry); past work values enhanced at 7% simple per annum
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Notarized affidavit that bidder is not blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State government organisation
Undertaking on letter pad that price bid is unconditional
Tender acceptance letter on letter pad; other documents per Section VI
notes: Document is the NIT only (printed page numbers 3-6); no BOQ included. Published date taken from bid document download start 24/12/2025 15:00 hrs. Bid submission end 13/01/2026 15:00 hrs; technical bid opening 14/01/2026 16:00 hrs. Affidavit clause inconsistent: Hindi says current year (2025), English says (2024).
